source: Well.
This hard's different.
Strange how that which is left behind can be the heaviest burden to carry.
left: 奇怪的是，留下來的東西 往往是最沉重的負擔。
right: 說也奇怪，被留在身後的東西 往往才是最沉重的負擔。

source: I miss my home, as well.
You don't even remember yours.
left: 你根本記不得自己的家。

source: No.
Sometimes, I perceive a glimmer of it nonetheless.
left: 不過有時候， 我還是能感受到一絲絲的記憶。
right: 但有時候， 我還是能感覺到一絲光影。

source: A longing for a feeling I can't remember or even name.
left: 一種渴望，一種我 說不出名字、也想不起來的感覺。
right: 對某種感覺的渴望 我記不得，甚至說不出名字。

source: But I know it's real.
Just beyond the sunset.
It appears we're being followed.
Come on, Your Majesty.
Not even kings can go without food.
right: 就算是國王也不能不吃東西。

source: Why don't you open up?
You tell old Waldreg everything you know about Sauron.
left: 把你知道的索隆的事， 都告訴瓦爾德雷格老頭吧。
right: 你把你對索隆的一切都告訴老瓦爾德雷格。

source: Pain must be something you enjoy.
right: 你一定很享受這種痛苦吧。

source: After Lord-father releases me, I'm going to kill you.
left: 等主父放了我， 我就要殺了你。
right: 等主父放我出去，我就殺了你。

source: Adar doesn't even remember you're here.
left: 阿達根本不記得你在這裡。
right: 阿達甚至不知道你在這裡。

source: Perfection.
Perfection exists only in Valinor.
Thank you, Master Círdan.
You needn't hide any longer.
Master Círdan.
Please forgive the unexpected nature of my visit,
left: 請原諒我來訪得如此唐突，
right: 請原諒我這次不請自來，

source: but I have nowhere else to turn.
You are the oldest and wisest of our kind.
left: 你是我們同族中最年長、最睿智的。
right: 您是我們族人中最年長、最有智慧的。

source: And the Elves are facing our greatest test in an age.
left: 而精靈族正面臨 數個紀元來最大的考驗。
right: 而精靈族正面臨這個時代最大的考驗。

source: I perceive you carry something in your charge.
left: 我感知到你掌管著某樣東西。
right: 我感覺到你身上帶著某種東西。

source: Something louder than the sea.
left: 某樣比大海還要喧囂的東西。
right: 比大海還要響亮的東西。

source: What have you brought here?
right: 你帶了什麼東西來這裡？

source: It is to be given directly to Lord Celebrimbor.
left: 這必須直接交給 凱勒布瑞博大人。
right: 要直接交給 Celebrimbor 大人。

source: He must be informed
that Halbrand is Sauron.
Move with haste,
and trust no stranger upon your path.
left: 路上別相信任何陌生人。
right: 路上不要相信任何陌生人。

source: Yes, my lord.
I have yet to thank you. For trusting me, regarding the Rings.
left: 我還沒謝過你。 謝謝你信任我，關於指環的事。
right: 我還沒感謝你。 感謝你相信我，關於這些戒指的事。

source: Trusting you?
Let us be clear, Commander.
left: 讓我把話說清楚，指揮官。

source: You and I are momentarily aligned for one reason,
left: 你我之所以暫時聯手， 只是為了一個原因，
right: 你我只是暫時站在同一陣線 只因為一個原因，

source: because your actions have left us no alternative.
left: 因為你的行動 讓我們別無選擇。
right: 因為你的所作所為， 讓我們別無選擇。

source: Because of you, our enemy lives.
left: 因為你，我們的敵人才能存活。
right: 因為你，我們的敵人活著。

source: Because of you, we've no choice but to test the virtue of the Rings.
left: 因為你，我們才被迫 去試驗這些戒指的力量。
right: 因為你，我們才不得不 測試指環的效用。

source: I should have you thrown in fetters
and cast to the Ettenmoors for what you've done.
left: 流放到伊騰荒原， 就憑你做過的事。
right: 並把你流放到伊坦荒野 來懲罰你所做的一切。

source: Then why have you not?
left: 那你為什麼還沒這樣做？

source: I am considering it.
I swear to you, High King,
I will not stop until he is destroyed and I have put this right.
left: 我不會停手，直到他被消滅， 我彌補這一切為止。
right: 我不會停止，直到他被摧毀 而且我已經彌補了這個錯誤。

source: You would not be here now if I thought otherwise.
left: 如果我認為不是這樣的話 你現在就不會在這裡。
right: 如果我不這麼想， 你現在不會站在這裡。

source: [female guard] High King, we have not found the Rings.
left: 高王殿下，我們沒有找到那些戒指。
right: [女守衛] 至高王， 我們還沒找到魔戒。

source: We've scoured everywhere water meets rock, and yet,
left: 我們搜遍了水與石相接的每個地方， 但是，
right: 我們搜遍了每個水巖交界之處， 但是，

source: there's no trace of him.
- Perhaps the fall-- - No.
left: 也許是那場墜落—— 不是。

source: Elrond lives.
Expand the search.
Set a watch at every crossing. He must not escape.
left: 在每個渡口都派人看守， 絕不能讓他逃脫。
right: 在每個渡口設定哨兵。 他不能逃脫。

source: Escape is not his plan.
Meaning?
He spoke of destroying the Rings.
right: 他說過要摧毀那些戒指。

source: Elrond would seek out someone he can trust.
left: Elrond 會去尋找 一個他能信任的人。
right: 艾隆德會去找他信任的人。

source: Someone older, wiser...
left: 一個更年長、更睿智的人。
right: 一個更年長、更有智慧的人……

source: Whose voice would command respect.
left: 說話能讓人心服口服的人。

source: Even from you.
Someone who could turn the tides his way.
left: 一個能扭轉局勢、對他有利的人。
right: 一個能夠扭轉局勢對他有利的人。

source: [Elrond] You may examine them.
left: 你們可以檢視這些魔戒。

source: I've seen Celebrimbor's work before.
left: 我以前見過 Celebrimbor 的作品。
right: 我以前看過凱勒布瑞博的作品。

source: - He's remarkable. - He is.
right: 他很不凡。 他確實是。

source: I remember, he used to speak of, one day, crafting objects of such power,
left: 我記得他曾說過，有朝一日 他要製作出如此強大的物品，
right: 我記得他曾說過，總有一天， 他要打造出力量強大的器物，

source: they could change the heart of any who beheld them.
left: 這些物品能夠改變 任何看到它們的人的心。
right: 強大到能改變任何見過它們的人的內心。

source: If, as you say,
these Rings have so quickly turned Elf against Elf...
left: 這些戒指這麼快就 讓精靈互相背離…
right: 這些魔戒這麼快就 讓精靈自相殘殺……

source: it would appear he has succeeded.
Perhaps it was not Celebrimbor's hand that produced that effect.
left: 也許不是 Celebrimbor 的手 造成了這種效果。
right: 或許造成這種效果的 不是凱勒布瑞博親手打造的。

source: If what you've told me is true,
left: 如果你告訴我的都是真的，
right: 如果你告訴我的是真的，

source: these three Rings were made without Sauron's touch.
left: 這三隻魔戒 並未經過索隆之手。
right: 這三枚戒指是在 Sauron 未曾觸碰的情況下製作的。

source: The Enemy is cunning.
The Rings may well be a ploy on his part.
left: 這些魔戒很可能是他的計謀。
right: 這些戒指很可能是他的詭計。

source: A device in some larger plan, the end of which we cannot yet see.
left: 是某個更大計畫中的工具， 我們現在還看不出結局如何。
right: 是某個更大計畫中的手段， 我們還看不到結局。

source: What would you ask of me?
The Rings must be destroyed.
Do so, and the Age of the Elves will end.
left: 這樣做的話，精靈族的時代就會結束。
right: 這麼做的話，精靈族的時代就會結束。

source: We would be abandoning all Middle-earth to its fate.
left: 我們就是在拋棄 整個中土，任由命運擺佈。
right: 我們將會放棄 整個中土的命運。

source: Could you accept that?
right: 你能接受這樣的結果嗎？

source: If to do otherwise means falling prey to the designs of the Enemy...
left: 如果不這樣做就意味著落入敵人的算計...
right: 如果不這麼做，就意味著 會落入敵人的計謀之中……

source: Yes.
You do your father proud.
right: 你沒有辱沒你父親的名聲。

source: Long ago, there was a battle.
left: 很久以前，發生過一場戰役。
right: 很久以前，曾有一場戰役。

source: One whose weapons were the very bones of the continents.
left: 一場戰役，其武器 是大陸本身的骨骸。
right: 那場戰役的武器 正是大陸本身的骸骨。

source: Still now, at the spot where our bay meets the sea,
left: 即使到現在，在我們的灣區 與大海相接之處，
right: 直到現在，在我們的海灣 與大海交會之處，

source: there remains on the seabed a scar so deep,
left: 海床上仍留有一道疤痕 深不見底
right: 海床上至今仍留有 一道深不見底的傷痕，

source: its end none but Manwë himself knows.
left: 深到只有曼威本人才知其盡頭。
right: 只有曼威本人才知道它的盡頭。

source: If one were to cast these Rings into its depths, they--
left: 若有人將這些魔戒 投入其深處，它們——
right: 若有人將這些戒指 投入那深淵，它們--

source: Let me speak with him first.
Please, High King.
Give me one last chance to reason with my friend?
left: 給我最後一次機會 勸說我的朋友？
right: 再給我最後一次機會 說服我的朋友？

source: Reason quickly.
Elrond?
I have come to coax you willingly.
left: 我是來勸你自願離開的。

source: If I fail, the High King will see you removed by force.
left: 如果我失敗了，高王 會強行帶你離開。
right: 若我失敗，至高王 會強行把你帶走。

source: I have failed enough of late, old friend.
left: 我最近失敗得夠多了，老朋友。
right: 我最近失敗得夠多了，老友。

source: Help me succeed this time?
right: 這次幫我成功一次好嗎？

source: I should have trusted you, as I asked you to trust me.
left: 我本應信任你， 就像我要求你信任我一樣。
right: 我早該信任你， 就像我要求你信任我一樣。

source: But unless we both trust in the Rings now, all will be lost.
left: 但除非我們現在都信任魔戒， 否則一切都將失去。
right: 但除非我們現在都信任這些戒指， 否則一切都會失去。

source: With three, there is balance.
Don't you remember?
We chose this path together.
left: 我們是一起選擇這條路的。
right: 我們一起選擇了這條路。

source: - No, you chose it for me. - Elrond--
left: 不，你是替我選的。 艾隆德——
right: 不，是你替我選擇的。 埃隆德—

source: What so frightens you, you cannot consider
left: 你到底在怕什麼，怕到連
right: 是什麼嚇得你， 讓你甚至無法考慮它們被腐化的可能性？

source: the possibility of their corruption?
right: 它們可能被腐化都不敢考慮？

source: Because in my heart,
I know The Three Rings are free of his influence.
left: 我知道三戒 不受他的影響。
right: 我知道三戒沒有受到他的影響。

source: But are you?
The light of Valinor shone upon your very face, Galadriel,
left: 瓦林諾的光芒照耀過 你的臉龐，卡蘭崔爾，
right: 瓦林諾的光曾照耀在妳臉上，葛拉翠兒，

source: and you turned your back on it.
Was it truly to fight the darkness or was the darkness calling to you?
left: 那真的是為了對抗黑暗， 還是黑暗在呼喚著妳？
right: 你真的是為了對抗黑暗， 還是黑暗在召喚你？

source: Can you not see? All this may be by his design.
left: 你看不出來嗎？ 這一切都可能出自他的設計。
right: 你難道看不出來嗎？ 這一切可能都是他的算計。

source: I did what I felt was right.
left: 我做的是我認為正確的事。
right: 我做了我認為正確的事。

source: And time alone will reveal whether that was folly or wisdom.
left: 唯有時間能證明 那是愚蠢還是智慧。
right: 只有時間才能揭曉 那是愚蠢還是智慧。

source: What time do you think you have?
left: 你以為自己還有多少時間？
right: 你以為你還有多少時間？

source: Where is Círdan?
You did what you must, Galadriel.
left: 妳做了妳該做的事，葛拉翠兒。

source: So have I.
Elrond.
Where are the Rings?
[Poppy] Huh?
Poppy!
[Nori] Mmm, honey biscuits.
Never been happier in my life than right now.
left: 我這輩子從沒 比現在更快樂過。
right: 我這輩子從沒有像現在這麼開心過。

source: How's everyone at home?
right: 家裡的每個人都還好嗎？

source: About the same.
Your ma took to giving me your chores,
left: 你媽媽現在把你的雜務都丟給我做，
right: 你媽把你的雜事都交給我做，

source: but your da said I didn't have to do 'em.
right: 不過你爸爸說我不一定要做。

source: You came after us.
left: 你是後來才跟上我們的。

source: Wasn't so hard. You haven't exactly gotten very far.
left: 沒那麼難。 你們也沒走多遠嘛。
right: 也沒那麼難啦。 你根本沒有走多遠嘛。

source: Yes, well, we appear to be lost.
So now you admit it.
Well, you won't be for long. Look.
left: 你們不會迷路太久的，你看。

source: I was sifting through Sadoc's old book.
left: 我翻了一下薩多克的舊書。
right: 我在翻 Sadoc 的舊書。

source: Harfoots must've journeyed this way a long time ago.
left: Harfoot 一族很久以前 一定走過這條路。
right: Harfoots 一定很久以前就走過這條路了。

source: See, there's a warnin',
"Not to forget the words to the song, or you'll just go round in circles."
left: 「別忘了歌詞， 不然你就會一直繞圈子。」
right: 「別忘了歌詞， 不然你會一直繞圈子。」

source: Song? What song?
Give you one guess.
Sing to me, sing to me, land far away
left: 唱給我聽，唱給我聽，遠方的土地
right: 唱給我聽，唱給我聽，遙遠的土地

source: - The walkin' song? - I think it's some kinda directions.
left: ─ 行走之歌？ ─ 我覺得這是某種方向指引。
right: -是那首行路歌嗎？ -我覺得那算是某種方向指引。

source: Our folk have been wanderin' for years.
left: 我們族人流浪了好多年。
right: 我們的族人流浪了好多年。

source: Guess this path must have been important to them.
left: 看來這條路 對他們來說一定很重要。
right: 這條路對他們來說 一定很重要。

source: I say, we climb.
right: 我的意見是我們往上爬。

source: "Trees of stone... Light in the tower, no longer my home."
left: 「石頭的樹⋯⋯塔樓裡的光， 已不再是我的家。」
right: 「石頭樹林……塔中之光， 不再是我的家。」

source: There.
"Past eyes of pale fire."
"Black sand for my bed."
"I trade all I've known for the unknown ahead."
left: 「用我所知的一切 換取前方的未知。」
right: 「我用我所知的一切 換取前方未知的世界。」

source: Welcome to the lands of Rhûn.
Come on. What are you waitin' for?
This is only the beginnin'.
Why you looking at it like that?
right: 你幹嘛用那種眼神看它？

source: Like what?
Like you've been here before.
left: 就像你以前來過這裡一樣。
right: 好像你以前來過這裡一樣。

source: Only in dreams.
- [gasping] - [clinking]
I was in your place once.
In the eldest of the Elder Days.
Thirteen of us were chosen to be blessed of Morgoth's hand,
left: 我們十三個被選中 被摩苟斯祝福，
right: 我們十三人被選中，接受摩哥斯之手的祝福，

source: with the promise of power.
A new birth.
I was led up to a dark and nameless peak.
left: 我被帶上一座黑暗無名的山峰。
right: 我被帶到一座黑暗無名的山峰。

source: Chained and left.
And after what seemed endless thirst and hunger...
left: 在經歷了看似無盡的 飢渴之後...
right: 在經歷了看似無盡的飢渴之後……

source: I saw it.
His servant's face.
Sauron's face.
And it was beautiful.
He offered me wine, red as a blood moon.
left: 他遞給我一杯酒，紅得像血月一樣。
right: 他遞給我葡萄酒，紅如血月。

source: He offered me wine, and on that dark and nameless peak,
left: 他遞給我一杯酒， 在那座黑暗無名的山峰上，
right: 他遞給我葡萄酒， 就在那座黑暗無名的山峰上，

source: I drank it.
I drank it all.
Your people have been set free.
left: 你的族人已經獲得自由。

source: Now, tell me what you know of Sauron.
left: 現在，告訴我你對索倫的瞭解。
right: 現在，告訴我你所知道的索隆。

source: Sauron has returned in a new form.
left: 索隆已經以新的形貌回來了。
right: 索倫以新的形態回歸了。

source: I am not yet certain what shape he has taken.
left: 我還無法確定 他現在是什麼樣子。
right: 我還不確定 他具體變成了什麼樣子。

source: Then of what use are you to me?
I have something you don't.
left: 我有一樣你沒有的東西。

source: The trust of the Elves.
Release me,
and I'll go to them and seek him out,
left: 我會去找他們，把他找出來，
right: 我會去找他們，幫你追蹤索倫，

source: so you can marshal your legions to destroy him.
left: 這樣你就能集結軍隊 把他消滅。
right: 這樣你就能集結軍隊 來消滅他。

source: Do you vow allegiance to Adar,
right: 你願意向阿達宣誓效忠嗎，

source: Lord-father of the Uruks?
Yes.
Then kneel.
Now, swear it.
- I vow-- - With your head at my feet.
right: 我發誓—— 把你的頭放在我腳下。

source: I vow to serve the Lord of Mordor.
To the end of my days...
and his.
[Waldreg] What're you doing? Keep away.
See that he's followed. Every step.
left: 派人跟著他。每一步都要盯著。
right: 讓人跟著他，一步都不能放過。

source: "I'm going to kill you."
Is that right, Your Majesty?
- All hail the king. - [thuds]
Oh!
- [growling] - [Waldreg screaming]
[Gil-galad singing in Quenya] O Elven-kind!
Too long have we dwelt Upon this Hither Shore
And now, a fading crown...
Must trade, to sail to Valinor
left: 須以此交換，方能航向瓦林諾
right: 必須交出，才能揚帆前往瓦林諾

source: O Elven-kind!
The Winter comes
The bare and leafless day...
O Elven-kind!
The leaves are falling in the stream
The river flows away
The light of the Eldar has faded.
left: 埃爾達人的光芒已褪去。
right: 精靈族的光輝已然褪去。

source: As coals too long removed from the hearth,
left: 如同長久遠離爐火的炭燼，
right: 猶如離開爐火太久的煤炭，

source: we must return to our home or diminish forever into endless night.
left: 我們必須回到家鄉 或永遠消融於無盡的黑暗之中。
right: 我們必須返回家園 否則將永遠沉淪於無盡黑夜之中。

source: And so it is come to pass,
left: 就這樣，時刻終於到來了，

source: our days in Middle-earth... are ended.
left: 我們在中土的歲月……已然結束。
right: 我們在中土的歲月……已經走到盡頭。

source: Perfection does not exist only in Valinor, High King.
left: 完美並非只存在於瓦林諾，陛下。
right: 完美並不存在 只存在於瓦林諾，至高王。

source: It is here.
Celebrimbor has brought it to Middle-earth.
left: 凱勒布瑞博已經 將它帶到中土了。
right: 凱勒布瑞博已將它 帶到了中土。

source: No!
Galadriel.
No.
[Mirdania] The new forge is remarkable, my lord.
left: 新的鍛爐真是了不起，大人。
right: 新的鍛造房真是非凡，我的領主。

source: It is, indeed.
Let us pray the Rings worked, so we have a chance to use it.
left: 但願魔戒真的成功了， 這樣我們才有機會用上它。
right: 讓我們祈禱那些魔戒有效， 這樣我們才有機會使用它。

source: Forgive me, my lord, but a messenger has just arrived.
left: 請原諒我，我的領主， 但信使剛剛抵達。
right: 請恕我打擾，大人， 有位信使剛剛抵達。

source: Word from Lindon?
To the contrary, my lord. This messenger is from the Southlands.
left: 恰恰相反，大人。 這位信使是從南方領地來的。
right: 恰恰相反，我的領主。 信使來自南境。

source: He says he wants to negotiate.
Well, my lord? Do we grant him entry?
left: 那麼，我的領主？我們要讓他進來嗎？
right: 大人，我們該讓他進來嗎？

source: [Gil-galad] I have seen mountains crumbling.
Waters running dry.
And clouds. Black. Gathering over white towers.
left: 還有烏雲。黑色的。 籠罩著白色的塔樓。
right: 還有烏雲。漆黑一片。 籠罩在白色高塔之上。

source: [Halbrand] A storm is coming.
[Galadriel] Prepare yourselves.
[Barrow-wight, whispering] I am waiting for you.
[Vorohil] Something has awoken them.
left: 有什麼東西把他們喚醒了。

source: No. Someone.
[The Dweller] It is said he has taken a new form to deceive his enemies.
left: [The Dweller] 據說他化作新的形貌， 來欺騙他的敵人。
right: 據說他已經變了新的形態來欺騙他的敵人。

source: - Who are you? - Annatar.
Lord of Gifts.
Sauron is alone, without army or ally.
left: 索倫孤身一人，沒有軍隊也沒有盟友。
right: 索隆孤身一人，沒有軍隊也沒有盟友。

source: He needs not armies... but Rings.
left: 他不需要軍隊...但他需要戒指。
right: 他需要的不是軍隊……而是戒指。

source: Seven Rings. Seven Dwarves. And bound within each, power.
left: 七枚戒指。七個矮人。 每一枚戒指內都蘊含著力量。
right: 七枚戒指。七位矮人。 每一枚都封鎖著力量。

source: [Halbrand] You saved the Elves. Make Rings for Men.
left: 你救了精靈。去為人類製造戒指。
right: [Halbrand] 你拯救了精靈族， 也為人類打造戒指吧。

source: We cannot give Rings to Men.
left: 我們不能把戒指交給人類。
right: 我們不能把戒指給人類。

source: The risk of corruption is simply too great.
left: 腐化的風險實在太大了。

source: [Annatar] True creation requires sacrifice.
In choosing to wear those Rings,
left: 選擇戴上那些戒指的時刻，

source: you have all chosen to become his collaborators.
left: 你們都選擇成為他的共謀者。

source: [Prince Durin IV] Take off the Ring.
left: [杜林四世王子] 把戒指拿下來。

source: I will defeat him. At any cost.
left: 我會打敗他。不惜一切代價。
right: 我會擊敗他，不惜任何代價。

source: No! This is what Sauron wants!
I've felt bound. To try and do something special.
left: 我一直感到被束縛。 想要做一些特別的事。
right: 我一直覺得自己有種使命。 要去做點特別的事。

source: You must remain calm at the storm's eye.
left: 你必須在風暴眼中保持冷靜。
right: 你必須在風暴中心保持冷靜。

source: This magic. Can you teach it to me?
[Tom Bombadil] If you prove yourself worthy of it.
left: 如果你證明自己值得學的話。
right: [湯姆·龐巴迪爾] 如果你證明自己配得上。

source: Sauron rises in the west. A Dark Wizard in the east.
left: 索隆崛起於西方。 一名黑暗巫師在東方現身。
right: 索隆在西方崛起。 東方出現了黑暗巫師。

source: Every soul in Middle-earth is in peril.
left: 中土的每一個靈魂都處於危險中。
right: 中土的每個靈魂都身陷險境。

source: Will you abandon them to their doom?
left: 你要讓他們自生自滅嗎？
right: 你要放棄他們，任由他們走向毀滅嗎？

source: [Elendil] Together we can put this right.
left: 我們齊心協力就能扭轉局面。
right: [埃蘭迪爾] 我們同心協力就能撥亂反正。

source: - Nobody goes off-trail. - [Nori] Nobody walks alone.
left: 沒有人能離開步道。 沒有人會獨自行走。

source: I need your axe, old friend. I need it now.
left: 我需要你的斧頭，老友。 我現在就需要。
right: 老朋友，我需要你的斧頭。 現在就要。

source: [Halbrand] Celebrimbor, you and I have work to do.
left: Celebrimbor， 你我還有工作要做。
right: [哈爾布蘭德] 凱勒布瑞博， 你我還有工作要做。
